Function Scalar(v As Variant) As String
Dim n As Long,s As String
If IsNull(v) Then
Scalar="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
Scalar="Empty(0)"
ElseIf IsError(v) Then
Scalar="CVErr(10)"
ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
s="Array(" & VarType(v) & ")[" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & "]"
For n=LBound(v) To UBound(v)
If n-LBound(v)>7 Then Exit For
s=s & "," & Scalar(v(n))
Next
Scalar=s
Else
Scalar=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
End Function
Function ReadP(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
ReadP=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
ReadP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function PutP(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
PutP="ok:" & ReadP(o,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
PutP="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Action(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbMethod)
Action=Scalar(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
Action="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function ParentType(o As Object) As String
Dim p As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set p=CallByName(o,"Parent",VbGet)
ParentType=TypeName(p)
Exit Function
Failed:
ParentType="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SeriesCount(c As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
SeriesCount=Scalar(c.SeriesCollection.Count)
Exit Function
Failed:
SeriesCount="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SeriesSnap(s As Object) As String
SeriesSnap="Name=" & ReadP(s,"Name") & ";Order=" & ReadP(s,"PlotOrder") & ";Formula=" & ReadP(s,"Formula") & ";Values=" & ReadP(s,"Values") & ";X=" & ReadP(s,"XValues") & ";parent=" & ParentType(s)
End Function
Function MakeChart(kind As Long,populated As Boolean) As Object
Dim co As ChartObject,w As Worksheet
Set w=ActiveSheet
w.Name="Data"
w.Range("A1").Value="Period":w.Range("B1").Value="Alpha":w.Range("C1").Value="Beta":w.Range("D1").Value="Gamma"
w.Range("A2").Value="Q1":w.Range("A3").Value="Q2":w.Range("A4").Value="Q3"
w.Range("B2").Value=10:w.Range("B3").Value=20:w.Range("B4").Value=30
w.Range("C2").Value=6:w.Range("C3").Value=12:w.Range("C4").Value=18
w.Range("D2").Value=8:w.Range("D3").Value=16:w.Range("D4").Value=24
Set co=w.ChartObjects.Add(10,20,360,216)
co.Chart.ChartType=kind
If populated Then co.Chart.SetSourceData w.Range("A1:D4"),xlColumns
Set MakeChart=co.Chart
End Function
Function SourceAttempt(c As Object,source As Variant,plot As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
c.SetSourceData Source:=source,PlotBy:=plot
SourceAttempt="ok"
Exit Function
Failed:
SourceAttempt="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function OnlySeries(c As Object) As String
Dim n As Long,s As String
On Error GoTo Failed
s="type=" & ReadP(c,"ChartType") & ";count=" & SeriesCount(c) & ";parent=" & ParentType(c)
For n=1 To c.SeriesCollection.Count
If n>4 Then Exit For
s=s & ";s" & n & "=[" & SeriesSnap(c.SeriesCollection(n)) & ";Index=" & ReadP(c.SeriesCollection(n),"Index") & "]"
Next
OnlySeries=s
Exit Function
Failed:
OnlySeries=s & ";SNAP-ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Snapshot=OnlySeries(ActiveSheet.ChartObjects(1).Chart)
End Function
Function CollectionGraph(o As Object,kind As Long) As String
Dim q As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set q=CallByName(o,"SeriesCollection",kind)
CollectionGraph=TypeName(q) & ";parent=" & ParentType(q) & ";Count=" & ReadP(q,"Count")
Exit Function
Failed:
CollectionGraph="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function ParentGraph(s As Object) As String
Dim p As Object,t As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set p=s.Parent
t="Series=" & TypeName(s) & ";Index=" & ReadP(s,"Index") & ";Parent=" & TypeName(p) & ";parentIndex=" & ReadP(p,"Index") & ";grandparent=" & ParentType(p)
t=t & ";collectionGet=[" & CollectionGraph(p,VbGet) & "];collectionCall=[" & CollectionGraph(p,VbMethod) & "]"
ParentGraph=t
Exit Function
Failed:
ParentGraph=t & ";GRAPH-ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function SeriesUdfAction(kind As Long) As String
Dim c As Object,g As Object,s As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Set c=Application.Caller.Parent.ChartObjects(1).Chart
s="caller=" & TypeName(Application.Caller) & ";count=" & SeriesCount(c)
If c.SeriesCollection.Count<>3 Then
SeriesUdfAction=s & ";notOriginalCount"
Exit Function
End If
Set g=c.SeriesCollection(3)
Select Case kind
Case 1
s=s & ";read=[" & SeriesSnap(g) & "]"
Case 2
s=s & ";putOrder=" & PutP(g,"PlotOrder",1)
Case 3
s=s & ";putName=" & PutP(g,"Name","UdfChanged")
Case 4
s=s & ";delete=" & Action(g,"Delete")
End Select
SeriesUdfAction=s & ";afterCount=" & SeriesCount(c)
Exit Function
Failed:
SeriesUdfAction=s & ";UDF-ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
